query: SELECT id, (extract($2 FROM created_at) * $3)::bigint AS sort_key FROM plan_documents ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT $1
SELECT id, doc - $2 AS doc, version, created_at, updated_at, jsonb_array_length(doc->$3) AS location_count FROM plan_documents WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])
SELECT id, doc, version, created_at, updated_at FROM plan_documents WHERE id = $1
SELECT doc - $2 AS doc FROM plan_documents WHERE id = $1
SELECT id, doc->$2 AS locations FROM plan_documents WHERE doc->$3 @> $1::jsonb FOR UPDATE
UPDATE plan_documents SET doc = doc || $1::jsonb, version = version + $4, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2 AND version = $3 RETURNING id, doc - $5 AS doc, version, created_at, updated_at
UPDATE plan_documents SET doc = jsonb_set(doc, $3, $2::jsonb) WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO plan_documents (id, doc) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id, doc, version, created_at, updated_at

UPDATE plan_documents SET doc = jsonb_set(doc, $3, doc->$4 || jsonb_build_array($2::jsonb || jsonb_build_object( $5, (SELECT coalesce(max((l->>$6)::int), $7) + $8 FROM jsonb_array_elements(doc->$9) l), $10, now()))) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING doc->$11->$12 AS location
